## What's Changed
* Add onshape_screenshot tool for Part Studio screenshots by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/173
* feat: add `onshape-mcp http` subcommand with Streamable HTTP transport and per-user OAuth by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/168
* Update Rust crate tokio to v1.50.0 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/174
* Update GitHub Actions by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/171
* Update Rust crate rmcp to v1 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/178
* Add mise lock validation to pre-commit hooks by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/180
* Update dependency npm:wrangler to v4.70.0 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/177
* Add Mergify merge queue, CI Insights, and auto-retry for flaky failures by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/179
* chore(deps): update actions/setup-node digest to 53b8394 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/181
* chore(deps): update dependency aqua:superfly/flyctl to v0.4.17 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/182
* Stop grouping GitHub Actions updates into a single Renovate PR by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/185
* chore(deps): update pre-commit hook mergifyio/mergify-pre-commit to v1.1.0 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/187
* Allow enforcing Mergify queue via required status check by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/192
* Simplify Mergify queue config: allow queueing before CI completes by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/208
* Fix Rust version resolution for Docker Hub release-day lag by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/203
* Use Mergify to auto-approve Renovate PRs instead of automerge by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/188
* all: if: ${{ !cancelled() }} by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/202
* chore(deps): update mergifyio/gha-mergify-ci action to v14 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/201
* Disable mise cache for lockfile validation job by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/210
* chore(deps): update dependency aqua:superfly/flyctl to v0.4.19 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/190
* chore(deps): update rust crate toml to v1.0.4 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/191
* chore(deps): update dependency npm:wrangler to v4.71.0 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/207
* chore(deps): update dependency @cloudflare/workers-types to v4.20260305.1 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/196
* chore(deps): update rust crate rmcp to v1.1.0 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/199
* chore(deps): update rust crate rand to 0.10 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/198
* Add knowledge pipeline design docs and knowledge base skeleton by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/213
* Add onshape_api_schema tool and discriminator annotations in explain output by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/214
* docs: add revolve insight and expand sketch/shaded-views documentation by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/217
* chore(deps): update mergifyio/gha-mergify-ci action to v15 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/216
* chore: only rebase Renovate PRs on conflicts, not when behind by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/218
* chore(deps): update jdx/mise-action digest to 5228313 by @altendky-renovat

## What's Changed
* fix: sync package-lock.json with version bump and automate lock file updates by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/156
* fix: treat already-published crates as success in cargo publish script by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/153
* chore(deps): update dependency vitest to v4 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/152
* chore(deps): update actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain digest to a0b538f by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/161
* feat: add standalone OAuth login flow via CLI and MCP tool by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/160
* chore(deps): update rust crate reqwest to 0.13 by @altendky-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/142
* fix: apply IP restriction to proxy /config endpoint and improve error handling by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/163
* chore: set keep_vars = true in wrangler.toml by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/165
* Expand version sync to cover all Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock locations by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/167
* Bump version to v0.3.0 by @altendky in https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/pull/170


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/altendky/onshape-mcp/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0
